questions.prompt: Two players show down and a third hand was mucked. That mucked hand…

choices.text: Can be retrieved if the player remembers it.
Wins if it would have been a straight.
Is shown by the dealer on request from a friend.

questions.explanation: A muck is not a live hand.

questions.prompt: Someone is speaking for the action or looking at a neighbor's hole cards. You…

choices.text: Tell the dealer. Do not police it by grabbing cards.
Announce their cards to the table.
Fold every hand in protest without a word.

questions.explanation: Report procedure and integrity problems to the dealer or floor.

questions.prompt: You need a table change. You…

choices.text: Pick up another player's chips as a joke.
Move the button to your new seat.
Ask the floor or brush and move only between hands.
Sit down in a new game while still dealt into the old one.

questions.explanation: One live hand at a time. Changes go through staff.

questions.prompt: A player wants you to soft-play their friend. The correct response is…

choices.text: Agree if the game is casual.
Show them your cards each hand.
Refuse. Soft-playing a partner is collusion.

questions.explanation: Playing a private alliance against the table is cheating, not etiquette.
